units.purpose: Run same-scenario legacy and candidate local-model comparisons, preserve all results, and select or exclude by the frozen Pareto rule.
retained_failures: The first independent comparison validation rejected a derived candidate failure-code map containing an unobserved zero-valued diagnosis_code_invalid entry; the immutable report and trace remained unchanged, the derived field was corrected, and the failure receipt is retained.

The first 37-validator wrapper invoked a phase-aware historical retrieval validator in preimplementation mode; its scenario and terminal checks were exact, the corrected --require-implementation inventory passes 37 of 37, and the orchestration failure is retained.

units.purpose: Verify the selected source, package, bounded MCP, authenticated API, approval and executor, persisted state, telemetry, rendered dashboard, local container, scan, and clean clone.
retained_failures: The first source API run passed 130 of 131 checks but rejected the stale baseline-0029 latest-evaluation pointer. The frozen baseline-0030 source candidate was then run, retained, trace-verified, and promoted byte-exact; the unchanged API passed 131 of 131.

Eight package-freeze process failures are retained: one read-only path guess, one trailing-blank-line exact-copy defect, one explicit CRLF/LF representation distinction, two focused-test fixture defects, one search-quoting failure, one read-only hash-wrapper parser failure, one credential-scan option-separator failure, and one upstream-ref wrapper that stopped before staging.

The first public reconciliation wrapper found the live public branch and GitHub API at dda0c347c108a78ac0afe279f09bc074c73579e9 but the separately stored local tracking ref at its parent, then stopped before remote-tree comparison. An exact branch fetch reconciled local reference state; the successor passes all four refs and 42 remote entries.

The first parallel package/source launch used an invalid PowerShell Test-Path expression and stopped before either evaluator started. Corrected parenthesized guards then produced both passing immutable runs.
The first post-surface validator inventory omitted PYTHONPATH=src and stopped during verify_model_comparison.py import after 22 passing validators. The corrected complete inventory passes 37 of 37.

The first post-surface repository parser used an unavailable System.Text.Json type and invalidly reported every nonempty artifact as a parser error. The corrected ConvertFrom-Json audit parses the complete repository without content error while retaining the one known historical zero-byte item.

A broad final credential scan read unchanged lines inside modified files and classified a historical documented private-key scanner literal as material. Its first corrected successor later encountered the artifact-scan receipt quoting that same classification. The final added-line plus complete-untracked scope classifies only the two evidence receipts and has zero unresolved credential findings.

The first staging wrapper was rejected before process creation because it used shell redirection to compare staged binary bytes. The index remained empty; the successor uses redirection-free Git blob identities.

The first combined status-and-push wrapper misparsed an unquoted Git tree revision after local commit 35a0f18f8e9cf54a56cec0eded620397a98f992f and stopped before push. The public branch remained at 4e1d8384d5f73f9d4c554529fca76e2205809438.

The first public package/source reconciliation-receipt wrapper omitted spaces in two PowerShell foreach statements and stopped at parse. The unchanged successor proved public commit dc5e72594b7919dbd75bf4d66f35615551ace900 exact across four refs and all nine changed paths.

The generated full container component receipt preserves stale non-authoritative next-gate text naming 43 checks. The frozen contract and canonical composition independently validate 46 of 46 checks; no component byte was rewritten.

The first post-container validator wrapper applied the implementation flag to a shortened nonexistent filename. The actual adversarial retrieval-stage contract correctly failed closed in preimplementation mode; the corrected complete inventory passes 37 of 37.

A --help orientation call to scripts/verify_baseline.py started a duplicate deterministic evaluation because that script has no argument parser. It was stopped after a complete trace but before report, anchor, or promotion; its manifest and trace are retained and classified invalid, and latest.json remained byte-exact.

The first core identity wrapper guessed a nonexistent clean-build tag after its preceding checks passed, and the first bounded credential scan omitted ripgrep -e for a leading-dash expression. Corrected successors verify all three live image tags and report zero high-specificity credential findings.

units.purpose: Audit, review, merge, release source plus zipapp only, and independently reconcile the public tag and selected assets.
retained_failures: Five read-only premerge orientation wrappers are retained as process-invalid: expected release absence became terminating, one release query requested an unsupported field, one latest-release assertion mishandled nested arrays, one target-release jq expression was over-escaped, and one paginated PR query combined unsupported --slurp and --jq options. Corrected scalar release and paginated path queries pass without mutation.

Merged-main verification retains import-path, byte-array, viewer, and historical-receipt wrapper failures as process-invalid. PowerShell 7 observes two null WWW-Authenticate header values and passes 129 of 131 live API checks; the unchanged validated Windows PowerShell path passes 131 of 131 with both server challenges exact. No security boundary or positive evidence was weakened.

Public-tag reconciliation retains a truncated console response, an empty-pipe PowerShell parser failure, browser screenshot and wait timeouts after page load, a corrected unsigned-tag wrapper, expected annotated-tag clone warnings, first-frame dashboard viewer artifacts, one unsupported release-query field, a transient release-view network timeout, and the intentional 45-plus-1 container receipt composition. Exact successors pass without rewriting unfavorable evidence.

next_action: Begin the next cycle from immutable public v0.0.30 by running the accepted system, inspecting traces and separately reported evaluation families, and selecting one highest-leverage measurable weakness before implementation.
